content.english: and beside me there is none that rescues. (Isaiah 43:11)

content.hebrew: Anochi higgadti vehosha‘ti vehishma‘ti ve’en bachem zar,
content.transliteration: אָֽנֹכִ֞י הִגַּ֤דְתִּי וְהוֹשַׁ֨עְתִּי֙ וְהִשְׁמַ֔עְתִּי וְאֵ֥ין בָּכֶ֖ם זָ֑ר
content.english: I have declared, and I have rescued, and I have announced, and there was no strange god among you;
therefore you are my witnesses, says Adonai, and I am God. (Isaiah 43:12)

content.hebrew: Attem ‘edai ne’um adonai ve‘avdi asher baḥarti,
content.transliteration: אַתֶּ֤ם עֵדַי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְעַבְדִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתִּי
content.english: You are my witnesses, says Adonai, and my servant whom I have chosen;

content.hebrew: *lema‘an tede‘u vetavinu ki ani hu lefanai lo notsar el ve’aḥarai lo yihyē.
content.transliteration: *לְמַ֣עַן תֵּֽ֠דְעוּ וְתַֽאֲמִ֨ינוּ לִ֤י וְתָבִ֨ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא לְפָנַי֙ לֹא־נ֣וֹצַר אֵ֔ל וְאַֽחֲרַ֖י לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
content.english: that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he; before me there was no god formed, neither shall any be after me. (Isaiah 43:10)
But I am Adonai your God from the land of Egypt; I will yet again settle you in tents, as in the days of the appointed season. (Hosea 10:12)

content.hebrew: Gam miyom ani hu ve’en miyadi mats-tsil,
content.transliteration: גַּם־מִיּוֹם֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְאֵ֥ין מִיָּדִ֖י מַצִּ֑יל
content.english: Yea, since day existed, I have been he, and there is none that can deliver out of my hand; I will act, and who can reverse it? (Isaiah 43:13)

content.hebrew: Mi fa‘al ve‘asa ḳorē haddorot merosh,
content.english: Who has acted and done it? He that called the generations from the beginning.

content.hebrew: *ani adonai rishon ve’et aḥaronim ani hu.
content.english: I, Adonai, who am the first, and with the last I am the same. (Isaiah 41:4)
Yet I am the Adonai your God since the Land of Egypt;

content.hebrew: *velohim zulati lo teda‘ umoshiya‘ ayin bilti.
content.transliteration: *וֵֽאלֹהִ֤ים זֽוּלָתִי֙ לֹ֣א תֵדָ֔ע וּמוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אַ֖יִן בִּלְתִּֽי׃
content.english: *and you know no god but me, and beside me there is no saviour. (Hosea 13:4)

content.hebrew: Anochi adonai elohecha hamma‘alcha me’erets mitsrayim,
content.transliteration: אָֽנֹכִ֨י ׀ יְהֹ֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ הַֽ֭מַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם
content.english: I am Adonai your God, who brought you up out of the Land of Egypt; open your mouth wide, and I will fill it. (Psalms 81:11)

content.hebrew: שִׁמְעָ֤ה עַמִּ֨י ׀ וַאֲדַבֵּ֗רָה יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ
content.transliteration: שִׁמְעָ֤ה עַמִּ֨י ׀ וַאֲדַבֵּ֗רָה יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ
content.english: Listen, my people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will arraign you,
